description: Android Fragment class implementing step sensor functionality with UI cards, handling sensor registration, events, and UI updates for a step counter/detector app.

classes.name: BatchStepSensorFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment managing step sensor registration, events, and UI cards for step counting/detection.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles fragment resume; initializes UI cards and sensor support check.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles fragment pause; unregisters sensor listeners.

methods.name: isKitkatWithStepSensor
methods.description: Checks if device supports step sensors and runs Android KitKat or higher.

methods.name: onCardClick
methods.description: Handles user interactions with UI cards to register/unregister sensors and dismiss info cards.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers sensor event listener with specified batch delay and sensor type.

methods.name: resetCounter
methods.description: Resets step counting variables and event data.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles sensor data events, updates step count, and UI cards.

methods.name: recordDelay
methods.description: Records delay of sensor events for performance monitoring.

methods.name: getDelayString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing recent sensor event delays.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current state variables for activity restoration.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores state variables and re-registers sensors if needed.

methods.name: showCountingCards
methods.description: Displays step counting UI cards and resets counters.

methods.name: showErrorCard
methods.description: Displays error UI card if sensors are unsupported.

methods.name: initialiseCards
methods.description: Initializes all UI cards for the app.

methods.name: getCardStream
methods.description: Retrieves cached CardStreamFragment for UI updates.
